architecture_rule: Core remains generic and reusable. Customer-specific business logic, data, confidential information, ERP mappings, workflows and proprietary processes belong in modules/configuration/adapters.

patch_policy.core_change: controlled Core patch with regression testing
patch_policy.customer_specific_logic: customer module/adapter, never embedded into Core

release_rule: Do not modify the frozen baseline directly. Create a new patch version and regression-test against this baseline.
